source.client: Claude Code 2.1.267 (proprietary). Captured billing header: `cc_version=2.1.267.d7f; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli`.
source.recorded: POST /v1/messages request body, one interactive turn, 25 flat tool declarations
source.vendored: STRUCTURE ONLY. Claude Code's system-prompt text (27k chars in the capture) and its tool descriptions are proprietary and are never committed. This fixture holds block kinds, ordering, cache-breakpoint placement, envelope field shapes, declaration/schema forms and naming conventions. Verbatim-text comparisons live in the local-only block of harness-golden-contract.test.ts and skip without OMP_HARNESS_CAPTURE_DIR / OMP_HARNESS_CACHE_DIR.
source.entrypointNote: The capture is the `sdk-cli` entrypoint, whose identity sentence is `You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.` and which carries a single prompt block. omp impersonates `cc_entrypoint=cli`, whose identity sentence is `claudeCodeSystemInstruction` and which precedes its main prompt with a `# Reporting outcomes` block. `systemLayout` collapses consecutive same-kind blocks, so both entrypoints project to the same three kinds and this golden covers either capture.

provenance.cachedSystemSlots: capture — breakpoints on the identity block and on the last system block, both `ephemeral` with a 1h TTL
provenance.prefixedToolNames: capture — declarations use the harness's own names, no transport prefix
provenance.envelope: capture — max_tokens 64000, adaptive thinking with a display field, context_management.edits, output_config.effort, no tool_choice
provenance.schemaForms: capture — JSON Schema objects carrying `$schema` (draft 2020-12), `additionalProperties` and `properties`
provenance.boundNaming: capture — every declared name is PascalCase

claude-fable-5-1.why: Fable 5 resolves a prefix-mismatch behaviour in catalog compat, so its thinking block carries `block_binding`. Model-lineage policy, not a harness-profile difference — the other profiled model (Opus 5) must not grow the field.

documentedInventoryDeltas.declarationForms: omp adds Anthropic's `eager_input_streaming` beta flag to every declaration (from catalog compat, not the profile) and `strict: true` to schema-strict tools; the captured client sends exactly `{description, input_schema, name}`. Behaviour-neutral for the backend, but a fingerprint difference on every request.
documentedInventoryDeltas.schemaForms: the captured client emits `"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"` on every `input_schema`; omp emits none. Same schema semantics, different bytes.
documentedInventoryDeltas.unboundNaming: by design: omp keeps `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, `learn`, `recall` and MCP tools that the harness has no counterpart for, so their names legitimately stay in omp's convention (`lowercase`, `mcp-qualified`). The vendor projection passes every captured name as bound, so its unbound set is empty. Membership is the free half of the two-tier contract; `boundNaming` — the half that must match — carries no delta.

notes.fingerprintVersion: omp's own wire fingerprint (`claudeCodeVersion` in packages/ai/src/providers/claude-code-fingerprint.ts) is 2.1.257, while the harness release these manifests and this golden were captured from is 2.1.267. The billing header and User-Agent therefore advertise an older CLI than the tool surface omp impersonates. Reported, not fixed here: bumping the fingerprint is a provider-owned change.
notes.betaList: omp's OAuth agent beta list (`claudeCodeAgentBetaDefaults` in packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts) and the client's diverge in both directions. The client's list carries `redact-thinking-2026-02-12`, `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20`, `effort-2025-11-24` and `extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11`, which omp omits (omp adds `effort-2025-11-24` only on thinking requests); omp sends `thinking-token-count-2026-05-13`, which the client's does not. The comparison list is sourced from the headers the client sends to the usage endpoint (`CLAUDE_HEADERS` in packages/ai/src/usage/claude.ts), so the `/v1/messages` beta list is inferred rather than captured. Betas are feature flags, not inert fingerprint strings: each one changes what the server accepts, and removing `thinking-token-count` would drop the thinking-token accounting omp relies on today. `ttl: "1h"` was accepted live on the OAuth agent path without `extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11`. Reported, not fixed here.
notes.cacheTailTtl: The capture pins system slots only (identity and prompt-last, both ephemeral/1h) and attests nothing about message-level cache_control, so omp matches the vendor on every slot the capture records. It deliberately diverges on the message tail: the tail is rewritten every turn and Anthropic charges 2x base input for a 1h write against 1.25x for 5m, so pinning it taxes every turn to insure against idle gaps measured at 0.8% of real inter-request gaps. Over 116 Fable 5.1 sessions (46,698 requests) head-1h/tail-5m cost $14,051 against $18,069 for uniform 1h. An explicit cacheRetention of long still pins both, which also keeps the label-driven keep-warm gate in stream.ts coherent.
